name: Xenosaga Episode II to III a missing year ~U.M.N. ni Fuuinsareshi Shinjitsu Danpen~
original_name: ゼノサーガ エピソードII to III a missing year 〜U.M.N.に封印されし真実断片〜
source: Xenosaga II to III: A Missing Year takes place six months after Xenosaga Episode II and tells the story of what happened between Xenosaga Episode II and Xenosaga Episode III.
translation: Xenosaga II to III: A Missing Year takes place six months after Xenosaga Episode II and tells the story of what happened between Xenosaga Episode II and Xenosaga Episode III.
